## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings` and `cargo test --workspace` pass
- [ ] New behaviour has a test with synthetic data (no real logs, tokens or account ids)
- [ ] No token is printed, logged or stored
- [ ] README updated if the app reads a new file or calls a new endpoint
